## Review: needs changes before merge

This PR is a **draft**. It **conflicts with `main`** (`6866890b6`). The author is not a collaborator, so the maintainer merges it by hand. I reviewed it on the maintainer's order, at head `241f6aeb5`.

The keep-out law is sound. One full-tool keep-out region (floor to clearance plane) is subtracted from the cutter-centre area, and both methods then run their plain planners over the reduced area. The Spiral path proves its entry (`Cert::Region(center)`) and its links (`links_center = center`) inside the reduced area, so the helix, the link moves and the plunges stay clear. The Trochoidal path holds every move in the reduced area (`check_path` -> `confined`). `generate.rs` still runs `route_links` and `verify_avoid` on the result, so a leftover gouge blocks the post.

### What looks good
- `adaptive_avoid.rs` is small (129 lines), has a provenance line, and has no `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!`.
- The no-item and keep-out-off cases call the plain planner byte for byte, and a motion test asserts that equality.
- The keep-out is taken over the whole cut height and uses the full cutter (flutes, shank, holder), so it matches the issue's "full tool" wording (#3346).
- An empty reduced area is refused with the item named, for both methods.
- `Changelog:` and `Fixes #3346` are present; every commit subject is conventional; no process file is touched; no new `camcraft-*` dependency line is added.

### Results on the PR head (built locally)

Built on the PR head `241f6aeb5` in a fresh worktree, with `RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache`, `-j 3`, no `CARGO_TARGET_DIR`. The trial merge with `main` `6866890b6` stops on the four conflicts below, so the local runs are on the PR head alone (not the merged tree).

- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test avoid_adaptive`: **6 passed, 0 failed** (40 s). All the new pins pass: spiral full-tool clearance, plain-path equality with no keep-out, the pass-start (Inside/Outside) variants, trochoidal clearance, trochoidal plain-path equality, and the no-room refusal with the item named.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings`: **clean**.
- The app end-to-end suite (`cargo test -p camcraft-app --test do_not_touch_adaptive`): **2 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored**. The ignored one is the heavy-lane ring test. `adaptive2d_do_not_touch_keeps_the_full_tool_clear_and_clears_back_to_the_plain_path` passes: the unprotected spiral gouges into the tower, the protected path verifies clean and posts, and undoing the protection returns the plain path move for move. `adaptive2d_with_no_room_clear_of_the_protection_is_refused_with_the_item_named` passes for both methods.
- The trial merge is **not built**. The four conflicts are all the same shape: both sides add one operation to the same list and text (`main` added `OpType::Finish3D`; this PR adds `OpType::Adaptive2D`). The sides are compatible - keep both - and there is no code-logic conflict. After the union the merged tree should build, but I did not build it.
- Not run here: `cargo xtask gate light`, and the heavy lanes. The author reports heavy 253 steps, 0 failed on this head; I did not rerun them.

### Requested before merge
1. **Merge `main` again.** The branches add different operations to the same four spots, so the conflict is a plain union, not a logic clash:
   - `crates/app/src/operation/types/avoid.rs:54` and `:71`
   - `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs:51`
   - `docs/agents/mcp-tools.md:34`
   - `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/do_not_touch.rs:181`

   `main` added `OpType::Finish3D` (#3347/#3495); this PR adds `OpType::Adaptive2D`. Take both. The text becomes `Trace, 2D Offset, 2D Adaptive, 3D Pocket, Face and 3D Finish`. Update both UI assertions to a substring of that text. Failure to do this leaves the merged tree with a stale "is supported on" note that no longer lists 2D Adaptive.
2. **Fix the Gate map in `crates/app/tests/do_not_touch_adaptive.rs:3`.** It names `motion::machining2d::adaptive_troch_avoid`, which is not a module; the module is `motion::machining2d::adaptive_avoid`. `pocket_avoid` is not used by the adaptive generator. With the wrong submodule name, `cargo xtask gate quick` picks the motion suite by submodule but drops this app suite when only `adaptive_avoid.rs` changes, so the end-to-end pin would not run.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)
- The issue's "Done means" asks for a "blocked post" on the no-room case; `adaptive2d_with_no_room_clear_of_the_protection_is_refused_with_the_item_named` pins the `generate` refusal only. The refusal blocks the post in practice (no cached path), so this is a note, not a blocker.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

## Review: ready for the maintainer to merge

This is a re-review of head `34ab20e80`, after the branch merged `main` `3fc0e017b`. The two findings of the last review are fixed. The union points with `main` keep both sides. The author is not a collaborator, so the maintainer merges by hand. The PR stays a draft.

### What looks good
- `generate.rs:997` keeps main's rest branch first. The arm is `(Some(r), _, _) => rest_adaptive_previous(...)`. The "Do not touch" arms run under `None` rest. The avoid-first order is gone. The `blend_turns` refusal is kept.
- A rest pass with "Do not touch" does not plan the keep-out, but it cannot post a hit. `verify_avoid` runs on every path (`generate.rs:3972`, `generate.rs:4127`), and `Warning::AvoidHit` blocks the post (`crates/sim/src/verify/types.rs:397`, `:441`). This is a named feature gap, not a wrong output. Follow-up #3702 covers it.
- The union points keep both sides:
  - `crates/app/src/operation/types/avoid.rs:54` and `:71`: `OpType::Adaptive2D` and `OpType::Finish3D` are both accepted. The text is "Trace, 2D Offset, 2D Adaptive, 3D Pocket, Face and 3D Finish".
  - `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs:51` and `docs/agents/mcp-tools.md:34`: the same text.
  - `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/do_not_touch.rs:181`: the assertion is a substring of that text.
- The Gate map is fixed. `crates/app/tests/do_not_touch_adaptive.rs:3` names `motion::machining2d::adaptive_avoid`. It no longer names `adaptive_troch_avoid` or `pocket_avoid`.
- `adaptive_avoid.rs` is 129 lines. It has a provenance line. The new non-test code has no `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!`. The added `expect` calls are in test files only.
- Process: no process file is touched. No dependency line is added. No golden or snapshot PNG changes. The body has a `Changelog:` line and ends with `Fixes #3346`. The commit subjects are conventional.

### Results on the merged head

The refresh worker ran these on `34ab20e80`. I read the code and the test plans. I did not rerun them.

- `cargo check -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app`: pass, 2 min 38 s.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test avoid_adaptive`: 6 passed, 0 failed, 48 s.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test do_not_touch_adaptive`: 2 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored (the heavy-lane ring test), 15 s.
- `cargo clippy --no-deps -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean, 3 min 3 s.

### Targeted tests (step 5)
- No example catalog case is touched. Without "Do not touch" both methods return the plain path byte for byte. The motion tests `an_empty_avoid_gives_the_plain_trochoidal_path` and `a_spiral_adaptive_with_no_keepout_on_the_region_is_the_plain_path` pin this. No example sets a protected item.
- Light lane (`cargo xtask gate light`), in the review worktree: 3 steps, all green. The release build passed. `the_slot_keeps_its_verdict_under_sub_micron_perturbations_light` passed (1/0). `wide_rectangular_pocket_is_cleared_by_parallel_lanes_light` passed (1/0). This is the full light plan for this tree.

### Requested before merge
None.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)
- The ui `do_not_touch` suite was not rerun on this head. The change is one label-text assertion and one structural test. The ui crate is clippy-clean. The author's ui run on the previous head passed.
- `crates/app/tests/do_not_touch_adaptive.rs` has a Gate-map line but no `Provenance:` line. The motion test has one.
- `generate.rs` is 4472 lines. This PR adds about 24. Flag only; the file is already over 400.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

## Re-review: the findings are closed

The two earlier findings are fixed on `34ab20e80`. The refresh merges with current main. The change is safe: rest plus "Do not touch" now keeps the rest plan first, and `verify_avoid` blocks the post on an `AvoidHit`. That is a feature gap, not a wrong answer. The author is not a collaborator, so a maintainer approves and merges by hand. The PR stays a draft.

### What looks good

- `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:997` keeps the maintainer's option A. The `(Some(r), _, _)` rest arm comes first. The avoid arms run only under `None` rest. The comment at `generate.rs:989` records the choice and the reason.
- The rest planner takes no keep-out, and `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:4126` still runs `verify_avoid` on the final path. `AvoidHit` is not exempt in `blocks_post` (`crates/sim/src/verify/types.rs:441`), so a hit holds the post. This is a named feature gap, not a silent gouge. Follow-up #3702 is open (`P8`, `effort:high`, `area:2d`).
- The four union conflicts keep both sides:
  - `crates/app/src/operation/types/avoid.rs:51` accepts `Adaptive2D` and `Finish3D`.
  - `crates/app/src/operation/types/avoid.rs:72` names "Trace, 2D Offset, 2D Adaptive, 3D Pocket, Face and 3D Finish".
  - `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs:51` and `docs/agents/mcp-tools.md:34` carry the same text.
  - `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/do_not_touch.rs:181` checks a substring of that text, and the new test at `:218` checks that no "is supported on" note shows for 2D Adaptive.
- `crates/app/tests/do_not_touch_adaptive.rs:3` names `motion::machining2d::adaptive_avoid`. It no longer names `adaptive_troch_avoid` or `pocket_avoid`.
- No safety rule is lost. The keep-out module is 129 lines, has a provenance line, and has no `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!`. No process file changes. No new `camcraft-*` dependency. The body has a `Changelog:` line and `Fixes #3346`. The commits are conventional.

### Results on the trial merge (built locally)

I merged `origin/main` `81643a2a4` into the PR head in a fresh worktree. The merge is clean. I ran the touched suites on the merged tree with `CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=3`, `-j 3`, no `CARGO_TARGET_DIR`, in the worktree's own `target/`.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test avoid_adaptive` | 6 passed, 0 failed (50.75 s) |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test do_not_touch_adaptive` | 2 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored (heavy lane) (12.50 s) |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib -- do_not_touch::` (CWD `crates/ui`) | 6 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy --no-deps -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean (2 m 51 s) |
| `cargo xtask gate light` | 3 steps, 0 failed (motion lib light, `adaptive_troch_parallel` light) |
| `example_catalog_adaptive::adaptive_pocket_case_roughs_above_the_finished_floor_then_finishes` | passed |

The light run used sccache. I used `--no-deps` for clippy, as the author did. Without it, clippy stops in `camcraft-gpu` (`needless_range_loop`), which this branch does not change and main has the same code.

### Targeted tests
- No post or toolpath output changes without protected items. The plain Spiral and the plain Trochoidal path are the same, and `avoid_adaptive` pins that equality.
- The 2D Adaptive example catalog case has no "Do not touch". Its recorded program passes. The full `regenerates` and `rebuilds` checks are heavy-lane and `#[ignore]`d. This is a `P3` PR, so #3556 does not owe a heavy step, and I did not run one.

### Requested before merge
None. The findings are closed.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)
- `docs/decisions/3346-adaptive2d-do-not-touch.md` does not name the rest plus "Do not touch" gap or #3702. The choice is recorded in `generate.rs:989` and in the merge commit message. This is enough to keep the rule, but a line in the decision file would help a later reader.
- On this review machine, one raw `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test example_catalog_adaptive` run failed with a metadata mismatch (`E0463`) in the sharded unit target dirs. The same test passed through `cargo xtask gate test`, which is the supported path. This is a local tooling quirk, not a defect in this PR.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
